request: Single exact-HEAD full AI Core Source suite after Core-owned model inference timing metrics addition; only on PASS build offline new image and prove exact Gate runtime source parity. No model starts or live service change.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = d6a11e719c39684334d5b432bfddd0d70e5c1c39
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
docker run --rm --network none --cpus 1 --memory 512m -v "$w:/src:ro" -w /src -e PYTHONPATH=/src --entrypoint python3 ai-core-model-gate:offline-01ef4da9 -m unittest discover -s tests -q
docker build --pull=false --network none -f "$w/Dockerfile.gate.refresh" --build-arg GATE_BASE_IMAGE=ai-core-model-gate:offline-01ef4da9 -t ai-core-model-gate:offline-d6a11e71 "$w/runtime" >/dev/null
want=$(sha256sum "$w/runtime/model_gate.py" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
got=$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum ai-core-model-gate:offline-d6a11e71 /app/runtime/model_gate.py | cut -d ' ' -f1)
test "$want" = "$got"
echo AI_CORE_FULL_SUITE_AND_OFFLINE_IMAGE=PASS
